segments.title: Cold Open: Ice-travaganza Launch
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station sign-on and introduces the ice face dunk marathon tied to bits and subs; Kendelle assists with water and lemon slices.

segments.title: Ice Dunk Marathon Begins
segments.notes: Case Blackwell performs the first 10 ice face dunks (25 seconds each) with lemon slices added; Chet Manscape interrupts to demonstrate 'correct' technique; lemon party theme established.

segments.title: News Desk: Trump Liberation Day Tariffs & Third Term
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple returns from hiatus to cover Trump's April 2 'Liberation Day' reciprocal tariffs, market volatility (S&P -4.6%, NASDAQ -10.5% Q1), and Trump's NBC interview claiming 'methods' for a third term despite 22nd Amendment.

segments.title: Trailer Thursday: Black Mirror S7, Legend of Wisely, King of Kings
segments.notes: Case and Jeff watch and rate trailers for Black Mirror Season 7, the 1980 film Legend of Wisely, and Angel Studios' animated King of Kings; chat rating system (Exclamation Point 1-5) used; sub/bits goals trigger additional ice dunks.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Gorilla Debt & Lemon vs Smirnoff Ice Debate
segments.notes: Crum reveals $155,000 debt to the Rock-afire gorilla ($5k per debate win); chat poll debates lemon ice face dunk vs Smirnoff Ice face dunk; Crum wins debate, avoids immediate gorilla punishment; Munch demands gorilla 'finish the job.'

segments.title: Creamy Ice Dunk Escalation & Kendall Participation
segments.notes: Whipped cream/cold foam creamer added to ice bowl at 20-dunk milestone; Kendall dunks her face; Case completes 10 rapid-fire dunks alongside instructional video; egg addition debated but rejected due to salmonella risk; ChetAI consulted on liquid identification.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Grandma Crumble Bottom, Vodka Tampons, Meth, Sexy Drawing
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget hosts from workshop with his father's spirit in a board; Grandma Crumble Bottom appears with dyed hair, dunks spectral face in ghost ice; segments cover vodka-soaked tampons (addiction), shake-and-bake meth (lithium, battery acid), and AI-generated sexy woman drawing (Florida map conspiracy).

segments.title: Clementine Redacted: Why British Accents Sound Smart
segments.notes: Clementine Redacted hijacks segment to debunk British accent intelligence perception via Chorus and Psychology Today articles; claims aristocratic Kentucky-Louisiana accent; refuses ice dunk, escapes before forced plunge.

segments.title: Failed Huckleberry Hound Call-Ins
segments.notes: Case attempts to book Huckleberry Hound; multiple impostors appear (talking dog with human body, dog-head-on-human-body 'Comet' variant); Jace (cousin of Jake from State Farm) fails to produce genuine Huckleberry; Case completes dunk 36 during chaos.

segments.title: DJ Newsic / Chet Rap Finale: Final Dunks & Face Water Shot
segments.notes: DJ Newsic hands off to Chet for hard country trap rap news rundown (Carl Jaffes liable for defaming Billy Mitchell, police/sex doll mix-up, California woman's tongue Jenga, Jessica Simpson snake sperm, Bryan Johnson age reversal); Case completes dunks 37-40, drinks shot of cream-lemon-face water, raids Christine (T-Lattes).

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosted the 'News Icestravaganza,' a 3+ hour marathon where he dunked his face in ice water every 600 bits/subs, completing 40 plunges and ultimately drinking a shot of the cream-lemon-face-oil mixture. Jeff Ripple returned from hiatus to cover Trump's 'Liberation Day' tariffs and third-term musings. The broadcast featured Trailer Thursday (Black Mirror S7, Legend of Wisely, King of Kings), a Munch & Crum debate on Crum's $155k gorilla debt, a How To with Jeb derailed by Grandma Crumble Bottom, Clementine Redacted's conspiracy segment on British accents, failed Huckleberry Hound call-ins, and a DJ Newsic/Chet rap finale before raiding Christine's channel.
